About Team & About Role
The Entra ID team builds products to protect the Rubrik customers’ Microsoft Entra ID data in Azure. It enables customers to efficiently recover their identity service in unforeseen circumstances such as a ransomware attack.
Our engineers are independent thinkers and proactive problem solvers, unafraid of complex technical challenges. We provide everyone the opportunity and support to thrive and reach their highest potential.
What You’ll Do
As a software engineer, you will be responsible for:
Contributing to the engineering design process with data-driven insights.
Completing well-defined tasks with quality and velocity, and taking on challenges with ambiguity.
Analyzing internal and field data to develop robust and maintainable products.
Troubleshooting issues from customer environment or internal testing and collaborating with team members and other teams to come up with solutions.
Experience You’ll Need
Degree in Computer Science and related fields
0-2 years of product development experience
Ability to identify scalable and elegant solutions to complex problems
Strong interest and ability to learn new technologies
Proficiency in Go, Python, C++
Experience in microservice design and implementation
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in architecting and developing large-scale systems, coupled with strong proficiency in data storage concepts
Experience in development in GCP/AWS/Azure or other public cloud technologies
Experience with popular IdP platforms or applications such as Entra ID and Windows AD
Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and identity security concepts (e.g., users, groups, roles, Non-Human Identities (NHI))

https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/44847.description_preview:
Cintal is a forward-thinking global technology company that develops and provides cutting-edge products and services to various industries such as heavy equipment, industrial, defense, agriculture, and medical. With our dedicated team of experienced technical professionals, Cintal aims to add value for its customers by leveraging advanced technologies to reduce product costs, shorten design and development lead times, and accelerate the introduction of high-quality products to the market.
Benefits
10 paid holidays per year
2 weeks of paid time off per year, the current year is pro-rated based on start date
Access to the company’s medical insurance, including dental and vision
Eligibility for life insurance and disability coverage for short or long-term disabilities or long- term care needs
401 (k) eligibility with employer contribution annually
Reimbursement for relocation expenses up to a certain amount on a case-by-case basis
Yearly bonus based on company performance
Job Description/Typical Task Breakdown
Support the integration, testing, and validation of autonomous truck control systems in both laboratory and field environments.
Execute system-level testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for autonomous vehicle functionalities.
Analyze test data, identify root causes of system issues, and collaborate with software and controls teams on corrective actions.
Develop and maintain test procedures, validation plans, and technical documentation.
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including software, controls, mechanical, and systems engineering groups.
Support field deployments and evaluate system performance, reliability, and safety.
Participate in debugging activities and verification of software releases and control system updates.
Ensure compliance with engineering standards, testing protocols, and quality requirements.
Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
2+ years of experience in controls engineering, systems integration, testing, validation, or product development.
Experience working with autonomous systems, vehicle controls, embedded systems, or off-highway equipment is preferred.
Hands-on experience with troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and system validation activities.
Familiarity with laboratory and field testing environments.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams in a product development setting.
Knowledge of data acquisition, analysis tools, and engineering documentation practices.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and technical reporting skills.
Required Technical Skills
Experience with control systems development, integration, testing, and validation.
Knowledge of autonomous systems, vehicle controls, embedded systems, or off-highway/mobile equipment.
Proficiency in troubleshooting and root cause analysis of hardware, software, and control system issues.
Experience with data acquisition, data analysis, and test reporting tools.
Understanding of system verification, validation methodologies, and test procedures.
Familiarity with CAN communication protocols, J1939, and vehicle network architectures.
Experience with diagnostic and calibration tools for control systems.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and technical specifications.
Working knowledge of software development and validation processes.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Software Engineer (.NET) to join our development team. Maintain comprehensive documentation for code, processes, software architecture, and technical decisions

Contribute to vendor management activities including technical evaluations and integration support

Understanding of financial technology domain and payment processing systems
Experience with message queuing systems (Apache Kafka)
Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (Application Insights, Grafana)
Microsoft certifications (Azure Developer Associate, .NET certifications)
Experience with vendor integration and third-party API management
Soft Skills

Mentoring and knowledge sharing skills with junior team members
Adaptability to changing requirements and evolving business needs
Customer focus and quality mindset in solution delivery
Cross-functional relationship building and stakeholder management
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with systematic approaches
Self-motivated with passion for continuous learning and professional development
Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects efficiently with competing priorities
Proactive approach in taking end-to-end responsibility for features and modules
Effectiveness in distributed or remote team environments
Vendor Management

Active participation in vendor evaluation sessions and technology assessment processes
Provide technical feedback on vendor tools, services, and API implementations
Document vendor-related processes, integration procedures, and technical specifications
Support procurement decisions with technical recommendations and risk assessments

Presents solutions to upper management.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Hands-on development experience on the Salesforce platform (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, SOQL/SAQL)
Strong experience with Salesforce CRM Analytics (Dashboards, Dataflows, Recipes, External Data Connectors)
Proven experience designing and optimizing large-scale datasets (millions of records) and data models
Experience with relational databases, SQL, and ETL/ELT data pipelines
Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs (JSON/XML)
Experience working in large, enterprise Salesforce environments (security, role hierarchy, territory models)
Experience with Agile methodologies (SCRUM)
Strong organizational, verbal, and written communication skills with ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
Salesforce Certified Platform Developer (I or II)
Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML capabilities (e.g., Azure OpenAI Service, OpenAI API, or similar) into applications to improve automation, insights, or user experience
Demonstrated ability to proactively identify, evaluate, and adopt new technologies to deliver measurable business impact
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with modern web technologies (HTML5, JavaScript, Angular or React)
Experience with Python or .NET for data processing or integration workflows (Python strongly preferred)
Experience optimizing performance across large datasets, APIs, and dashboards
Experience building mobile-first or field-based applications
Experience with geospatial or mapping-based solutions (e.g., proximity, location services)
Experience with CI/CD, version control, and modern development practices
Experience working with cross-functional teams in global or multi-region environments
Minimum Education
Bachelor’s Degree/equivalency in business, finance, economic, computer science, engineering or related field.
Minimum Experience
Five (5) years work experience in measurement and analysis, quantitative business problem solving, operations analysis, sales or marketing analysis and/or knowledge management. A related advanced degree may offset the related experience requirements.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Innovative analytical skills.
Superior demonstrated skills in access, excel and other database/analytical tools.
Excellent interpersonal, written and oral communication skills including presentation skills.

From Ramping to Observability, this org powers the AI products that define LinkedIn. This team, inside MLOps, is responsible for AI Metadata, Observability, Orchestration, Ramping and Experimentation for all models; building tools that enable our product and infrastructure engineers to optimize their models and deliver the best performance possible.
